purpose: Three decorative illustrations for empty candidate collection, empty itinerary and docent guidance.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production raster illustration asset for PinDay, a Korean travel planner for adults in their twenties and thirties. Match an established polished travel editorial art direction: fine clean navy outlines, soft watercolor and paper-grain color blocks, gentle dimensional shading, cobalt blue #0066ff, pale aqua and turquoise, ivory and restrained warm coral accents. Sophisticated and friendly, crisp enough to remain legible at a small web display size. Square transparent cutout with one compact focal group centered, all main objects fully visible, generous transparent padding around it. No words, letters, numerals, typography, labels, logos, watermark, UI screenshots, background rectangle, border or checkerboard pattern. Real alpha transparency, no solid background. Decorative conceptual illustration, no claim of depicting a real tourist attraction. Subject: an inviting empty travel collection waiting for a first saved place. A small open ivory travel folder or keepsake box with a simple cobalt bookmark tab, a folded aqua map resting lightly inside, and one large cobalt location pin floating just above the open folder as if ready to be saved. A restrained coral four-point sparkle and two tiny aqua motion strokes. Mostly open uncluttered composition, a calm welcoming mood. The folder looks clean and ready, not abandoned or broken. No dice, no person, no text.
